narrative: Iran’s weekend talks regarding a joint mechanism in the Strait of Hormuz dominate the tape, as any perceived supply risk would likely support crude and commodity-linked CAD and AUD at the Tokyo open. The USD faces additional scrutiny after Friday’s hawkish Fed split, with the 1.51% real rate advantage likely to anchor the greenback. USD/JPY closed Friday at 157.1, but JPY outperformance—led by a +3.000% G10 strength score and a -2.53 risk reversal skew—sets up for further downside pressure at the open. EUR/USD closed Friday at 1.1551; it may face resistance near-term as the +146bp SOFR-ESTR carry differential favors the USD ahead of the RBA decision on August 11.
